reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a SAME RECORD AREA clause names several files, the compiler must refuse the program if the file description entry or any record description entry of any of those files writes GLOBAL; GLOBAL on files named only in SAME AREA or SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses is not barred by this rule.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 the report-file row of the occurrence limits (not this rule; same function, read on the path)

reader.edition-search: Read ScreenSameClauses' GLOBAL loop (sites of SameClauseKind.RecordArea, f.IsGlobal or any record HasGlobalClause): no DialectLevel/Edition.Year/ConstructRegistry read in that loop; the only edition switch in the function family is SameOccurrenceRule's report-file arm, which this rule does not reach (no report file in the probes, so the arm taken is the same for the other kinds).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover GLOBAL on the FD and on a record of a SAME RECORD AREA file; not exercised: GLOBAL on a non-first record of the file, a sort file sharing a record area with a GLOBAL FD, and the accept half (GLOBAL files in SAME AREA / SAME SORT AREA only)

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2738: SAME RECORD AREA: the file description entry of file 'F1' includes the GLOBAL clause
EXIT 65, COBOL2738: the record description entry of file 'F2' includes the GLOBAL clause (second record R2 GLOBAL)
EXIT 65, COBOL2738 for FD F1 GLOBAL in SAME RECORD AREA FOR S1 F1 (sort file plus GLOBAL file)
EXIT 0, ABCDEFGHIJ (GLOBAL FD/records only in SAME AREA and SAME SORT AREA; record area shared F1/F2 works at run time)

reader.notes: One edition-blind loop in ScreenSameClauses refuses GLOBAL on an FD or record of any file a SAME RECORD AREA names, at --std 85 as at 2023. A malformed first probe (r2c) drew SR9/SR10 refusals of its own and was replaced by r2e. The message cites §2023:13.18.27.3 SR2 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1 admits GLOBAL on any 01 of the File Section, so an SD record may carry it: x2a SAME RECORD AREA FOR S1 F1 with '01 SR1 IS GLOBAL' under SD S1 -> EXIT 65 COBOL2738 'record description entry of file S1 includes the GLOBAL clause'. The report-file arm the reader left unprobed (SameOccurrenceRule's below-2002 row): x2b FD RPTF IS GLOBAL REPORT IS RPT in SAME RECORD AREA -> COBOL2738 for the report file in a record-area clause AND COBOL2738 for its GLOBAL FD; x2c without GLOBAL -> only the report-file refusal. Accept half: x2d GLOBAL FD F3 and GLOBAL record outside the SAME RECORD AREA FOR F1 F2 -> EXIT 0 'ABC' (area shared). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.4.6.3 SR3  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'.
